meta.title: Leadership — Members
meta.description: How members build leadership skills through meeting roles, officer positions, and Toastmasters' leadership pathways.

page_hero.headline: Leadership is a practised craft.
page_hero.intro: Members grow into leadership through meeting roles, club officer positions, and the leadership tracks in Pathways.

unique_approach.body: Our club has a unique approach to leadership development. To learn more, please email us.

sections.heading: Every meeting is member-run
sections.body: Chair the meeting, run Table Topics, evaluate a speech, keep time, or track filler words. Each role is a small, structured leadership rep — you get one every Wednesday. The detailed role guide is on the main Members page.

sections.heading: Take on a club officer role
sections.body: Elected officer terms are six months. Roles include President, VP Education, VP Membership, VP Public Relations, Secretary, Treasurer, and Sergeant-at-Arms. Each role runs a piece of the club and represents real project-management practice — with a supportive board around you.

sections.heading: Structured leadership tracks
sections.body: Of the six remaining Pathways paths, Dynamic Leadership and Strategic Relationships are the most direct leadership tracks; Visionary Communication and Innovative Planning both put leadership skills to work at scale.
